shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "pwd && sed -n '1,240p' ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md; fi && sed -n '1,260p' .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch && git log -5 --oneline && sed -n '1,240p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && sed -n '1,230p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml && sed -n '1,260p' ../round-brief.md"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"interface ToolDefinition|type ToolDefinition|inputSchema\" src/types/ai.ts package.json package-lock.json | head -40 && sed -n '1,100p' src/types/ai.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg --files scripts | rg 'spec-links/reanchor|reanchor' || true && npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,80p' && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '1,180p' && rg -n \"validated by\" specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts --runInBand"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git diff --check && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "feat(tools): validate registered tool input" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch'
